{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
patient_id_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_id_counts[patient_id_counts > 1]

duplicate_count = len(duplicate_patients)
print(f'Duplicate patient_ids: {duplicate_count}')

# Check sample_seq per patient
df_sorted = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
df_dedup = df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Verify we kept one row per patient
assert len(df_dedup) == len(df['patient_id'].unique()), 'Deduplication did not result in one row per patient'

# Check the assay_batch conversion
print(f'Assay_batch A: {df_dedup[df_dedup.assay_batch == "A"].shape[0]} rows')
print(f'Assay_batch B: {df_dedup[df_dedup.assay_batch == "B"].shape[0]} rows')

# Convert batch B values from µg/L to ng/mL (divide by 10)
df_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final']
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup.assay_batch == 'B', 'biomarker_final_ngml'] = df_dedup.loc[df_dedup.assay_batch == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] / 10

# Compute the mean of biomarker_final_ngml
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'].mean()

# Print result
print(f'Mean biomarker_final (ng/mL): {mean_biomarker_final:.2f}')"}
